pinned.name: NeuronDump
pinned.description: Look inside any local LLM (GGUF from Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, Jan, llama.cpp): layers, heads, vocabulary, chat template, weights. Explore it as a 3D graph, follow a token through every layer, edit it live (ablate, steer, ban, patch), diff two models, then bake or slim a new GGUF that still runs. CLI, web UI, browser demo. Runs 100% offline
